en.name: Vampiric Spirit
en.description: Steal up to 15...60 Health from target foe. For 10 seconds, you have +5...10 Health regeneration.
en.concise: Steal 15...60 Health from target foe. You have +5...10 Health regeneration (10 seconds).

fr.concise: Vous volez 5...50 points de vie à la cible ennemie. Vous bénéficiez d'une régénération de santé de +5...10 (10 secondes).
